content: Public vs internal dashboard separation: a public-facing view must be a genuinely separate code path/disclosure contract, not an authenticated internal dashboard with elements hidden by UI/role checks -- generic 'is authenticated' checks (rather than per-role/per-visibility-level checks) are a common vuln class that leaks role-specific data to the wrong viewer. Regression tests should assert the public route returns only allowed fields even when queried directly, independent of what the UI chooses to render.
